original_test_intent: Validate six PDB-side PSU power channels, PSU1 through PSU6, with correct fitted supply/feed/channel provenance, readable values and enabled thresholds in exact raw evidence and both Web views.
original_method: The power owner maps each PSU bay and serial to AC feed, PDB connector/controller channel and measurement boundary, supplies load/redundancy limits, and automation collects passive complete evidence without issuing OEM BIOS or power-control commands.
manual_activity: The power owner maps all fitted PSU serials and AC feeds to PDB connectors/controller channels, defines PDB measurement semantics and redundancy-state limits, and confirms both Web views. No PSU service or power transition is authorized.
required_inputs: PSU1–PSU6 bay, serial, AC-feed and fitted/applicable inventory
PDB revision, connector/rail and controller/channel mapping
Measurement point as PSU output, PDB input/output, rail segment or derived aggregate
Units, scaling, accuracy, sampling/averaging and freshness
Approved per-channel ranges, enabled thresholds and load-share/imbalance rules by redundancy state
Exact SDR/entity and both Web mappings
Secret-safe passive collection, full retention and independent power/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1862 and variant; never run the duplicate BIOS OEM command for this sensor case
Enumerate six records and bind each to a fitted PSU serial/feed/PDB channel
Do not substitute PSU-internal PMBus or motherboard-side power without approved equivalence
Retain complete SDR and thresholds; no capped fallback
Do not remove a PSU, change AC feeds/load, issue PMBus/power/threshold writes, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale power, unsafe imbalance, redundancy loss, rail/thermal fault or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant and six-path PDB topology
Collect complete read-only SDR and six exact PDB-PSU records
Parse values, states, sampling/freshness and enabled thresholds
Prepare both Web views and passive load-share/redundancy context
Perform no BIOS command, PSU service, power/PMBus control or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve PSU/feed/PDB-channel mapping and measurement boundary
Provide redundancy-state ranges, thresholds and imbalance rules
Confirm Web mappings and applicability for unfitted bays
Review six results and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The passive sensor direction fits row 1862 only after exact names are mapped; literal range, truncation, password argument and missing PDB/Web provenance prevent readiness. OEM raw 0x30 0x25 belongs solely to the duplicate BIOS variant.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through secret-safe OOB access, retain full SDR and query each owner-mapped PDB-PSU channel separately, then reconcile the same PSU serial/feed/channel in both Web views.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PDB PSU1~6, both Web paths and 1/1-minute estimates remain; BIOS-version scope and 5/5-minute timing are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES PDB PSU-CHANNEL POWER MAPPING AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a six-row PSU-serial/feed/PDB-channel matrix and reconcile passive raw/Web power with redundancy and load-share rules.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds PDB electrical provenance and quarantines the duplicate BIOS-version variant.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BIOS OEM success, PSU-internal PMBus or motherboard totals cannot substitute for six PDB channels.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A swapped PDB channel or unrecognized aggregate can hide a failed or overloaded feed while total power appears normal.

project_override_considerations: Unfitted bays require explicit N/A rules. Shared PDB shunts or combined rails need a versioned allocation showing which PSU paths a value legitimately covers; one aggregate must not be duplicated into six passes.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and duplicate-BIOS separation audit
Measurement semantics, SDR/entity and both Web mappings
Values, units, sampling/freshness, enabled thresholds and load-share limits
Complete redacted SDR and six exact outputs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1862 consistently defines PDB PSU power sensors. The BIOS-version procedure is confined to a distinct duplicate-code row and is not an internal conflict in this variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive six-channel PDB power check is identifiable; topology, measurement semantics and limits are supplyable inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Quarantines the unrelated BIOS variant and adds fitted-supply, PDB-channel, measurement-boundary and redundancy provenance for all six channels.
independent_technical_reasoning: The duplicated code creates a severe evidence-identity hazard: an error-free BIOS raw response could be credited to a critical power test. Even within the power row, PDB shunts may represent connectors, combined rails or derived totals rather than PSU-internal output. Six explicit serial/feed/channel bindings are needed before load share or thresholds can be judged.
